cap_2026_27.second_apron_hardcap_rule: A team hard-capped at the second apron may add outside free agents essentially only on veteran-minimum contracts; it cannot spend past the second apron for any reason. The taxpayer MLE remains technically usable only if it fits UNDER the hard cap. Source: hoopsrumors 2026-27 MLE/min values; NBA.com salary-cap release.
